en: The postcard features a sepia-toned image of a formal garden with neatly trimmed hedges, palm trees, and people strolling or seated on benches. The back contains handwritten German text, a green postage stamp bearing the emblem of the Deutsches Reich, and printed words indicating 'Bad Pyrmont' and 'Partie aus dem Palmengarten.' There are also museum and production marks, as well as an address area.
